## What's changed

- Added capability-negotiated Tube TV output for Apple TV: up to 4K HDR10 on compatible displays, with the best supported SDR resolution used otherwise.
- Holds resolution, dynamic range, video codec, frame cadence, audio codec, and audio layout stable across programs, commercials, and bumpers to avoid repeated HDMI mode changes.
- Places SDR programming naturally inside a fixed HDR10 channel signal while retaining SDR brightness and contrast, and safely falls back to SDR when the required color conversion is unavailable.
- Reports the selected Tube TV output resolution and dynamic range in active-stream details and exposes the fixed frame rate in the player playback plan.
- Improves the Tater Core recommendation candidate feed with rotating, genre-balanced movie and television selections, recently used exclusions, and weekend-morning priority for animation and family titles.
- Keeps Steam, retro players, and older Apple TV clients on their existing playback behavior unless they explicitly request the new fixed Tube TV output.
